verses.ar: «اُدْعُ ٱلْآنَ. فَهَلْ لَكَ مِنْ مُجِيبٍ؟ وَإِلَى أَيِّ ٱلْقِدِّيسِينَ تَلْتَفِتُ؟
verses.kjv: Call now, if there be any that will answer thee; and to which of the saints wilt thou turn?
verses.web: “Call now; is there any who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلْغَيْظَ يَقْتُلُ ٱلْغَبِيَّ، وَٱلْغَيْرَةَ تُمِيتُ ٱلْأَحْمَقَ.
verses.kjv: For wrath killeth the foolish man, and envy slayeth the silly one.
verses.web: For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.

verses.ar: إِنِّي رَأَيْتُ ٱلْغَبِيَّ يَتَأَصَّلُ وَبَغْتَةً لَعَنْتُ مَرْبِضَهُ.
verses.kjv: I have seen the foolish taking root: but suddenly I cursed his habitation.
verses.web: I have seen the foolish taking root, but suddenly I cursed his habitation.

verses.ar: بَنُوهُ بَعِيدُونَ عَنِ ٱلْأَمْنِ، وَقَدْ تَحَطَّمُوا فِي ٱلْبَابِ وَلَا مُنْقِذَ.
verses.kjv: His children are far from safety, and they are crushed in the gate, neither [is there] any to deliver [them].
verses.web: His children are far from safety. They are crushed in the gate. Neither is there any to deliver them,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَأْكُلُ ٱلْجَوْعَانُ حَصِيدَهُمْ، وَيَأْخُذُهُ حَتَّى مِنَ ٱلشَّوْكِ، وَيَشْتَفُّ ٱلظَّمْآنُ ثَرْوَتَهُمْ.
verses.kjv: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, and taketh it even out of the thorns, and the robber swalloweth up their substance.
verses.web: whose harvest the hungry eat up, and take it even out of the thorns. The snare gapes for their substance.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْبَلِيَّةَ لَا تَخْرُجُ مِنَ ٱلتُّرَابِ، وَٱلشَّقَاوَةَ لَا تَنْبُتُ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ،
verses.kjv: Although affliction cometh not forth of the dust, neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;
verses.web: For affliction doesn’t come out of the dust, neither does trouble spring out of the ground;

verses.ar: وَلَكِنَّ ٱلْإِنْسَانَ مَوْلُودٌ لِلْمَشَقَّةِ كَمَا أَنَّ ٱلْجَوَارِحَ لِٱرْتِفَاعِ ٱلْجَنَاحِ.
verses.kjv: Yet man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
verses.web: but man is born to trouble, as the sparks fly upward.

verses.ar: «لَكِنْ كُنْتُ أَطْلُبُ إِلَى ٱللهِ، وَعَلَى ٱللهِ أَجْعَلُ أَمْرِي.
verses.kjv: I would seek unto God, and unto God would I commit my cause:
verses.web: “But as for me, I would seek God. I would commit my cause to God,

verses.ar: ٱلْفَاعِلِ عَظَائِمَ لَا تُفْحَصُ وَعَجَائِبَ لَا تُعَدُّ.
verses.kjv: Which doeth great things and unsearchable; marvellous things without number:
verses.web: who does great things that can’t be fathomed, marvelous things without number;

verses.ar: ٱلْمُنْزِلِ مَطَرًا عَلَى وَجْهِ ٱلْأَرْضِ، وَٱلْمُرْسِلِ ٱلْمِيَاهَ عَلَى ٱلْبَرَارِيِّ.
verses.kjv: Who giveth rain upon the earth, and sendeth waters upon the fields:
verses.web: who gives rain on the earth, and sends waters on the fields;

verses.ar: ٱلْجَاعِلِ ٱلْمُتَوَاضِعِينَ فِي ٱلْعُلَى، فَيَرْتَفِعُ ٱلْمَحْزُونُونَ إِلَى أَمْنٍ.
verses.kjv: To set up on high those that be low; that those which mourn may be exalted to safety.
verses.web: so that he sets up on high those who are low, those who mourn are exalted to safety.

verses.ar: ٱلْمُبْطِلِ أَفْكَارَ ٱلْمُحْتَالِينَ، فَلَا تُجْرِي أَيْدِيهِمْ قَصْدًا.
verses.kjv: He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform [their] enterprise.
verses.web: He frustrates the plans of the crafty, so that their hands can’t perform their enterprise.

verses.ar: ٱلْآخِذِ ٱلْحُكَمَاءَ بِحِيلَتِهِمْ، فَتَتَهَوَّرُ مَشُورَةُ ٱلْمَاكِرِينَ.
verses.kjv: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.
verses.web: He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.

verses.ar: فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ يَصْدِمُونَ ظَلَامًا، وَيَتَلَمَّسُونَ فِي ٱلظَّهِيرَةِ كَمَا فِي ٱللَّيْلِ.
verses.kjv: They meet with darkness in the daytime, and grope in the noonday as in the night.
verses.web: They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope at noonday as in the night.

verses.ar: ٱلْمُنَجِّيَ ٱلْبَائِسَ مِنَ ٱلسَّيْفِ، مِنْ فَمِهِمْ وَمِنْ يَدِ ٱلْقَوِيِّ.
verses.kjv: But he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.
verses.web: But he saves from the sword of their mouth, even the needy from the hand of the mighty.

verses.ar: فَيَكُونُ لِلذَّلِيلِ رَجَاءٌ وَتَسُدُّ ٱلْخَطِيَّةُ فَاهَا.
verses.kjv: So the poor hath hope, and iniquity stoppeth her mouth.
verses.web: So the poor has hope, and injustice shuts her mouth.

verses.ar: «هُوَذَا طُوبَى لِرَجُلٍ يُؤَدِّبُهُ ٱللهُ. فَلَا تَرْفُضْ تَأْدِيبَ ٱلْقَدِيرِ.
verses.kjv: Behold, happy [is] the man whom God correcteth: therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty:
verses.web: “Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ هُوَ يَجْرَحُ وَيَعْصِبُ. يَسْحَقُ وَيَدَاهُ تَشْفِيَانِ.
verses.kjv: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up: he woundeth, and his hands make whole.
verses.web: For he wounds and binds up. He injures and his hands make whole.

verses.ar: فِي سِتِّ شَدَائِدَ يُنَجِّيكَ، وَفِي سَبْعٍ لَا يَمَسُّكَ سُوءٌ.
verses.kjv: He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.
verses.web: He will deliver you in six troubles; yes, in seven no evil will touch you.

verses.ar: فِي ٱلْجُوعِ يَفْدِيكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَوْتِ، وَفِي ٱلْحَرْبِ مِنْ حَدِّ ٱلسَّيْفِ.
verses.kjv: In famine he shall redeem thee from death: and in war from the power of the sword.
verses.web: In famine he will redeem you from death; in war, from the power of the sword.

verses.ar: مِنْ سَوْطِ ٱللِّسَانِ تُخْتَبَأُ، فَلَا تَخَافُ مِنَ ٱلْخَرَابِ إِذَا جَاءَ.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue: neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh.
verses.web: You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, neither will you be afraid of destruction when it comes.

verses.ar: تَضْحَكُ عَلَى ٱلْخَرَابِ وَٱلْمَحْلِ، وَلَا تَخْشَى وُحُوشَ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh: neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.
verses.web: You will laugh at destruction and famine, neither will you be afraid of the animals of the earth.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ مَعَ حِجَارَةِ ٱلْحَقْلِ عَهْدُكَ، وَوُحُوشُ ٱلْبَرِّيَّةِ تُسَالِمُكَ.
verses.kjv: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field: and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.
verses.web: For you will be allied with the stones of the field. The animals of the field will be at peace with you.

verses.ar: فَتَعْلَمُ أَنَّ خَيْمَتَكَ آمِنَةٌ، وَتَتَعَهَّدُ مَرْبِضَكَ وَلَا تَفْقِدُ شَيْئًا.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt know that thy tabernacle [shall be] in peace; and thou shalt visit thy habitation, and shalt not sin.
verses.web: You will know that your tent is in peace. You will visit your fold, and will miss nothing.

verses.ar: وَتَعْلَمُ أَنَّ زَرْعَكَ كَثِيرٌ وَذُرِّيَّتَكَ كَعُشْبِ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt know also that thy seed [shall be] great, and thine offspring as the grass of the earth.
verses.web: You will know also that your offspring will be great, your offspring as the grass of the earth.

verses.ar: تَدْخُلُ ٱلْمَدْفَنَ فِي شَيْخُوخَةٍ، كَرَفْعِ ٱلْكُدْسِ فِي أَوَانِهِ.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt come to [thy] grave in a full age, like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season.
verses.web: You will come to your grave in a full age, like a shock of grain comes in its season.

verses.ar: هَا إِنَّ ذَا قَدْ بَحَثْنَا عَنْهُ. كَذَا هُوَ. فَٱسْمَعْهُ وَٱعْلَمْ أَنْتَ لِنَفْسِكَ».
verses.kjv: Lo this, we have searched it, so it [is;] hear it, and know thou [it] for thy good.
verses.web: Behold, we have researched it. It is so. Hear it, and know it for your good.”
